mechanism_narrative: Sustained low federal funds rates compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline for corporate valuation models.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 9.5% signal deteriorating consumer spending capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as recession fears dominate market sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 540 thousand units indicate robust residential construction, driving consumer confidence and retail sales growth that produces positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST > 540 thousand.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production and employment signals manufacturing sector strength, correlating with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO and PAYEMS both show positive month-over-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payrolls signal expanding labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending power and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate accelerating consumer demand, fueling corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both show positive month-over-month growth.
